_about: Round 2 blind fluency verdicts: 812 first ratings of f11_l2 Chinese continuations (20/model) plus 160 SECOND ratings of round-1 passages under fresh keys, mixed into the same batches so a judge cannot tell a re-rate from a first rating. Judged by 16 Claude Opus 5 agents via m06_zh_fluency_judge.js with the round-1 instructions VERBATIM. 971 of 972 returned; r20807 (Falcon3-1B-Base sample 17) was dropped by its agent and is reported as missing rather than backfilled.
